mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a waxing crescent moon. Also, keep your eyes on the southern horizon over Belleville starting at 5:43 PM to catch the ISS as it travels east toward Fitchburg for a three-minute pass.

The city has shared important updates for the 2027 spring election, as all four aldermanic districts will be on the ballot. Candidates must submit their paperwork by 5:00 PM on January 5. Additionally, the city is moving forward with the Military Ridge State Trail paving project to improve accessibility, with a public information meeting set for December 8.

There is plenty to do this week. Today features live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, tomorrow brings trivia nights at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
On October 25, officers responded to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, where a 40-year-old man was arrested for O W I after being found passed out behind the wheel.
Today's flavor is the delightful Chocolate Caramel Twist. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10:00 PM tonight, so stop by and grab a treat while you can.
